en.headline: Fire Services Department steps up inspections ahead of APEC finance meeting
en.dek: Special patrols and enforcement will cover the Convention and Exhibition Centre, MTR stations, chemical suppliers and petrol stations before the 20-21 October gathering.
body: The Fire Services Department said it has rolled out comprehensive special security arrangements for the APEC Finance Ministers’ Meeting to be held in Hong Kong on 20 and 21 October.

The department has stepped up routine safety inspections, risk checks, special patrols and enforcement operations covering the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, MTR stations, construction sites, typhoon shelters, hardware stores, chemical suppliers, dangerous goods warehouses, waste recycling yards and petrol filling stations.
The meeting, the first of its kind hosted in Hong Kong, will bring together finance ministers or representatives from the 21 APEC economies.

zh.headline: 消防處為APEC財長會議加強巡查及執法
zh.dek: 特別安排涵蓋會議展覽中心、港鐵站、化工供應商及油站等，確保10月20至21日會議順利舉行。
body: 消防處表示，已全面推出特別保安安排，以確保將於10月20至21日在香港舉行的APEC財長會議順利進行。
署方已加強例行安全巡查、風險檢查、特別巡邏及執法行動，範圍包括香港會議展覽中心、港鐵站、建築地盤、避風塘、五金店、化工供應商、危險品倉庫、廢料回收場及油站。
這是香港首次主辦APEC財長會議，將有21個經濟體的財長或代表出席。
